concepts.name: Hafting
concepts.summary: Joining a worked stone, bone or metal head to a separate handle or shaft to make one composite tool.

concepts.name: Metal woodworking tool kit
concepts.summary: A set of metal-bladed saws, chisels, adzes and drills that makes fine carpentry, joinery and dressed stonework possible.

concepts.name: Toothed gearing
concepts.summary: Passing rotation from one shaft to another, and changing its speed, force or direction, through meshing toothed wheels.

concepts.name: Cam-operated powered hammers
concepts.summary: Using lugs or cams on a turning shaft to lift and drop hammers, so that rotary power does pounding work.

concepts.name: Hydraulic press
concepts.summary: Multiplying force by pressing on a confined liquid with a small piston so that a large piston pushes far harder.

concepts.name: Screw pump
concepts.summary: Raising water by turning a helix inside a sloping tube or trough.

concepts.name: Crane
concepts.summary: Lifting and placing heavy loads with a rope run over pulleys from a winch on a raised frame.

concepts.name: Passenger elevator
concepts.summary: A powered lift with an automatic safety catch that carries people between the floors of a building.

concepts.name: Lathe
concepts.summary: Shaping a workpiece by spinning it against a cutting tool.

concepts.name: Milling machine
concepts.summary: Cutting metal to a set shape by feeding the work past a rotating multi-toothed cutter.

concepts.name: Standardised serial production
concepts.summary: Making large numbers of near-identical goods to a set pattern in supervised workshops with divided tasks and checks on quality.

concepts.name: Factory system
concepts.summary: Bringing workers and powered machines together under one roof to work set hours under supervision.

concepts.name: Interchangeable parts
concepts.summary: Making components so alike, by machines, fixtures and gauges, that any one fits any assembly without hand fitting.

concepts.name: Moving assembly line
concepts.summary: Carrying the work past fixed stations at a set pace so that each worker repeats one short task.

concepts.name: Just-in-time production
concepts.summary: Making each part only when the next step calls for it, with little stock, and stopping the line to fix causes of defects.

concepts.name: Punched-card machine control
concepts.summary: Storing a machine's sequence of actions as holes in paper or card, so that changing the cards changes what it makes.

concepts.name: Automatic control engineering
concepts.summary: Designing self-correcting machines and processes by analysing feedback, using controllers that act on the measured error.

concepts.name: Industrial robot
concepts.summary: A reprogrammable mechanical arm that carries out handling or tooling tasks in a factory without an operator.

concepts.name: Built dwelling
concepts.summary: Constructing a lasting house from gathered materials instead of relying on caves, rock shelters or windbreaks.

concepts.name: Jointed timber-frame building
concepts.summary: Building with squared timbers held by cut joints such as the mortise and tenon, so that a frame carries the roof and floors.

concepts.name: Industrialised panel housing
concepts.summary: Casting room-sized concrete wall and floor panels in a factory and assembling blocks of flats from them by crane.

concepts.name: Monumental construction
concepts.summary: Building works far larger than any dwelling, by organised communal labour, for ceremony, burial or display.

concepts.name: Dressed-stone masonry
concepts.summary: Building large structures from stone blocks quarried and cut to fit in regular courses.

concepts.name: Arch and vault
concepts.summary: Spanning an opening or roofing a room with wedge-laid units that carry load by pressing against one another.

concepts.name: Skeleton-frame tall building
concepts.summary: Carrying a building's whole weight on an internal frame of metal columns and beams, so that walls become a light skin and height is no longer limited by masonry.

concepts.name: Mud brick
concepts.summary: Shaping earth mixed with straw or other temper into blocks, drying them in the sun and laying them as walls.

concepts.name: Lime burning
concepts.summary: Roasting limestone to quicklime and slaking it to make plaster and mortar that set hard.

concepts.name: Hydraulic concrete
concepts.summary: A mix of lime, a reactive volcanic ash or similar material, and rubble that sets into artificial stone, even under water.

concepts.name: Portland cement
concepts.summary: A hydraulic cement made by firing limestone and clay to clinker at high temperature and grinding it to powder.

concepts.name: Reinforced concrete
concepts.summary: Embedding iron or steel bars in concrete so that the metal takes tension and the concrete compression.

concepts.name: Dug well
concepts.summary: Sinking a lined shaft to reach groundwater, so that a settlement need not sit beside a river or spring.

concepts.name: Dam
concepts.summary: A barrier built across a watercourse to store water or turn it aside.

concepts.name: Qanat
concepts.summary: A gently sloping tunnel, dug from a line of shafts, that leads groundwater out to the surface by gravity.

concepts.name: Polder reclamation
concepts.summary: Winning farmland from marsh, lake or sea by enclosing it with dikes and pumping the water out.

concepts.name: Treated public drinking water
concepts.summary: Filtering a town's water supply and dosing it with a disinfectant so that it does not carry disease.

concepts.name: Membrane desalination
concepts.summary: Making fresh water from sea or brackish water by forcing it under pressure through a membrane that holds back salt.

concepts.name: Urban drainage and sewerage
concepts.summary: A connected system of drains under or beside a town's streets that carries waste water away from every house.

concepts.name: Night-soil collection for fertiliser
concepts.summary: An organised trade that removes human waste from town houses and sells it to farmers as manure.

concepts.name: Suspension bridge
concepts.summary: Crossing a gorge or river on a walkway hung from cables or chains anchored at each bank.

concepts.name: Controlled-access motorway
concepts.summary: A road for motor vehicles only, with no crossings at grade and entry limited to junctions.

concepts.name: Sedentary village
concepts.summary: A community living in permanent houses in one place all year, generation after generation.

concepts.name: City life
concepts.summary: Many thousands of people living densely in one planned or governed place, most of them not farming, served by a surrounding countryside.

concepts.name: Land-use zoning
concepts.summary: A municipal rule that divides a town into districts and fixes what may be built in each and how densely.
